subject: ROLLBACK statement
notes: cite.py --check 14.9.36.3 "This statement shall not be specified in a recursive source element." -> OK §14.9.36.3 1). Recursive = explicit RECURSIVE clause and any program contained in one (cite.py --check 11.10.4 "The RECURSIVE clause specifies that the program and any programs contained within it are recursive." -> OK 4)), every method (--check 9.3.4 "A method always possesses the recursive attribute and may call itself." -> OK) and every user-defined function (--check 9.4 "a user defined function always possesses the recursive attribute and may call itself" -> OK). BindCommitRollback rejects on UnitRecursive || InMethod || UdfSelfName with COBOL1690 Error. Probes on the pinned cobol.exe (out/probe/rollback/): rb1_recursive (PROGRAM-ID RECURSIVE) -> COBOL1690; rb2_nested_in_recursive (non-RECURSIVE program contained in a RECURSIVE one) -> COBOL1690; rb5_method -> COBOL1690; negative control rb7_outer_nonrec (ROLLBACK in a non-recursive program that CONTAINS a recursive one) compiles and runs (INNER / OUTER-OK). The golden pb137-rollback-in-function covers the function arm with ROLLBACK itself; the explicit-RECURSIVE arm is golden-covered only for COMMIT (pb137-commit-recursive), which reads the same predicate.
